description.name: Entry
description.text:
Fifteen single-target Ice/Water/Lightning/NE magical attacks (? each), grants [Quick Magic (15s)] & Ice/Water/Lightning Damage +20% to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Triple Sphere Mode (Ice, Lightning, Water)], & (Awoken Well-Informed Guardian Mode) to user
Awoken Well-Informed Guardian Mode: Unlimited Ice/Water/Lightning Hones, Ice/Water/Lightning Ability Boost & Dualcast Ice/Water/Lightning

description.name: Triple Sphere Mode (Ice, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%
